images.alt: European PAL Nintendo 64 front box art for V-Rally Edition 99, showing two rally cars

rows.notes_markdown: Partial matching decompilation of the Nintendo 64 European revision 0 release (NVLP). Requires a user-supplied ROM and rebuilds using reconstructed C plus original assembly for remaining functions. A byte-identical cartridge build does not establish complete C decompilation. Compiler identity, function boundaries, names and types remain provisional. [The README documents AI-assisted source reconstruction](https://github.com/RetroReversing/v-rally-decomp#readme).
